stats.text:
You can take the {ref:glossary/dash} action as a {ref:glossary/bonus-action}. When you do so, you gain a number of {ref:glossary/temporary-hit-points} equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Short or {ref:glossary/long-rest}.
